easyPrerequisites:
Cinderhaze Wretch exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Xavier Sal using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

uses.name: Xavier Sal, Infested Captain
uses.cardState: with a +1/+1 counter and without summoning sickness
